scope: every question of the 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 Preliminary Paper-I in data/pyq/mymppsc-pyq-bank.json
method: Each stored answer was re-derived from independent subject reasoning and reliable sources rather than accepted from the printed key. Questions whose answers had previously been changed, questions flagged unresolved, questions where the printed key conflicted with the stored answer, multi-answer and defective items, explanation/answer contradictions and malformed option sets were investigated first; the remainder were checked against their explanation and printed key for internal consistency.

categories.corrected: Stored answer was demonstrably wrong; changed and synchronised with the explanation, the correction manifest and the reports.
categories.ambiguous: Stem defective, evidence conflicting or more than one answer defensible; uncertainty stated and not forced to a single key.

questions.note: Official key D ("All of the above") is wrong: the phosphatase test is a milk test.
Auctions are cited both as B2B and as C2C; two options satisfy the stem.
A router, a brouter and a gateway each forward packets between networks; the stem does not isolate one.
Turra-Kalangi is staged in Malwa, Nimar and Bundelkhand; sources disagree on the single home region.
The 13 December 1946 sitting is counted as second, third, fourth or fifth by different sources.
Stem says "leader of the house" but the key follows the Leader of the Opposition reading, on which option A also qualifies.
Sanchi and Bulsar both lack Buddhist caves; two options satisfy the stem.
Statements (i) and (ii) are both true, and options A, B and D are each literally true.

The paper keys both B and D; the National Programme for Prevention and Control of Fluorosis is listed among the Health Ministry's national nutritional programmes, although fluorosis is fluoride toxicity.
